paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Front Centre Bumper Trim is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this motorsport-inspired component replaces the factory centre bumper insert with a more aggressive, more open carbon fibre design.

By eliminating the restrictive vertical uprights of the factory insert, the Alpha-N trim significantly opens the centre intake area. The improved airflow path increases cooling efficiency for the radiator and oil cooler while transforming the front fascia into a more purposeful motorsport-styled face. Integrated lower aero foils subtly guide airflow toward the cooling system without sacrificing rigidity.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Gloss clear coat with UV protection (matte clear available on request)
